fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure; Scattered Vegetation
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Clear vegetation along both sides of the driveway to allow full-width vehicle passage.
• Keep the access drive free of parked vehicles so emergency vehicles can reach the residence without delay.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure to allow responders to move around it on foot.
• Mark any rear access points clearly so responders arriving at the front can quickly locate alternate routes to the back of the property.
• Remove or thin scattered vegetation that would block responder movement between the main residence and detached structure.
• Keep a clear parking area near the front of the property so arriving emergency vehicles have a designated staging location.
• Trim any overhanging branches along the access drive that could obstruct tall emergency vehicles such as fire trucks.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Vegetation Near Structure; Grass Cover; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Long Driveway; Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Along Driveway; Woody Debris; Mixed Vegetation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing close to the house on all visible sides.
• Thin trees in the cluster nearest to the structure to create more open space between them.
• Remove dead branches, fallen limbs, and woody debris piled near or around the structure.
• Clear shrubs and low-hanging branches along both sides of the driveway to keep it passable.
• Trim any tree branches that hang over or touch the driveway to maintain clear vehicle access.
• Mow or cut grass growing close to the structure, especially where it contacts the foundation or siding.
• Remove woody debris scattered across the property, starting closest to the structure and working outward.
• Thin shrubs growing along the driveway edges so vehicles can move through without obstruction.
• Separate mixed shrubs and small trees that are growing together in dense patches near the structure.
• Keep the area directly around the structure clear of loose plant material, dead grass, and fallen debris.
